description: Na₂ZnBr₄ is Spinel-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZnBr₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaBr₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ZnBr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-59°. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.92-2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with eight NaBr₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent ZnBr₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnBr₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-59°. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.01 Å. Zn is bonded to four Br atoms to form ZnBr₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaBr₆ octahedra and edges with three NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-59°. There are a spread of Zn-Br bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.44 Å. There are three inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded to three Na and one Zn atom to form distorted corner-sharing BrNa₃Zn trigonal pyramids. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Zn atom. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Zn atom.
